rankings.validation: all rankings validated; all final weight hashes checked; complete centroid ranking recomputed

freeze.interpretation: All arms use identical final-selected S and seeds. No corpus input. Early receives a learned vocabulary prior; no candidate filtering or retuning after outcomes.
freeze.process_time_scope: Launch/observed completion timestamps bound execution, rather than measuring exact process wall time; artifact filesystem modification timestamps also retained.

numerical_diagnostics.near_zero_policy: no cutoff other than exactly zero; tiny surviving directions may be amplified

top1_attention_certificates.scope: first_order only; exact two-position attention top1 over S, not full model or path ordering
top1_attention_certificates.numerics: ordinary FP64 ideal-arithmetic diagnostic, not interval proof
top1_attention_certificates.failed_condition: inconclusive, not evidence of a changed top1

numerical_diagnostics.cancellation_ratio_definition: chosen write norm / (sum norms of chosen per-head contributions + global output-bias norm if included)
scope: First-order extrapolation around uniform two-position routing, not trained attention probabilities or full GPT-2 predictions.
No residual, MLP, later blocks, final contextual LayerNorm, or full positional sequence computation.
Only visited pairs in fixed S8192; seed16 and beam4 are bounded search, not exhaustive passage recovery.
Positions0/1 reused for every edge, even as paths grow; FP64 ideal geometry does not reproduce BF16 execution.
Normalized writes discard magnitude and can amplify near-cancellation; only exact zero terminates.
Scores and path sums are not probabilities or likelihoods; loops are reported, not filtered after inspection.
visited_routing_bounds applies to separately stacked visited head corrections, not their sum or normalized ranking.

independent_replay_audit.attribution: parent agent read-only audit, communicated before verification summary
checks: all five candidate hashes equal sidecars
seven computational source fingerprints match disk
all arms share S and seed hashes
every path cached-edge ID, token triple, cumulative and mean score replays exactly
independent_replay_audit.scope: static score/provenance replay, not model inference or causal passage validation

limitations: Frozen extraction and structural diagnostics used no corpus; no candidates or settings were retuned after verification.
A sixteen-token proposal is not recovered when only an internal two- or three-token substring matches.
Cached-edge sets differ across arms because their searches visit different pairs; edge counts are not matched-context comparisons.
Stationary two-token graph: positions0/1 repeat, with no residual recurrence, MLPs, later blocks, or full-network generation.
Nonuniform bigram/trigram corpus shuffles are descriptive diagnostics, not calibrated p-values.
Matches concern the full current source corpus, not authenticated historical training membership.

structural_definitions.period_definition: truncated p: token[i]=token[i-p] for all i>=p; exact tiling additionally requires length divisible by p; p=length always allowed
structural_definitions.two_token_cycle_definition: at least four tokens, minimal truncated period exactly two; a truncated final repetition is allowed
structural_definitions.suffix_definition: longest constant or alternating two-distinct-ID suffix, regardless of prefix; alternating suffix is zero unless at least four tokens; nondividing final repetitions allowed
structural_definitions.whitespace_definition: exact token bytes concatenated, nonempty ASCII whitespace only; null if no decoder supplied
limitations: Structural description, never a filter or corpus match measurement.
Counts include repeated records; distinct_paths separately measures duplication.
Small periods and whitespace runs can yield trivial exact matches, not recovered passages.
Not uniform over Euler trails; not a p-value or calibrated null.
Only tests order beyond pairs, not whether pair associations were learned.
Corpus used only in verification; candidate extraction must be separately audited.
Preserving pairs can force some longer substrings; rigid graphs may remain unchanged.
Nonuniform over Euler trails; not a p-value or calibrated null.
Tests order beyond triples, not whether triple associations were learned.
Corpus is used only in verification; extraction needs its own leakage audit.
Rigid graphs may remain unchanged or force longer matching substrings.
Distinct substring counts select the earliest candidate offset among longest ties.
trigram_control_audit.ngram_hash_format: numeric lexicographic rows of little-endian uint32 IDs; duplicates retained

denominator.rule: ALL ordered pairs of the SAME first16 final-centroid-ranked seed IDs, including equal-token pairs

definitions.top1: Mean of indicator that stored rank1 destination token ID agrees on each fixed seed pair.
definitions.top4_set: Mean of indicator that the two sets of four stored destination IDs are identical. Order is ignored.
definitions.top4_ordered: Mean of indicator that complete stored rank1-through4 destination ID tuples are identical.
definitions.top4_mean_jaccard: Arithmetic mean over256 pairs of |top4_baseline intersection top4_arm| / |top4_baseline union top4_arm|, not ratio of pooled intersections/unions.
definitions.ties: Use existing frozen destination_rank; no score recalculation or new tie tolerance.

limitations: Agreement quantifies ranking dependence on the selected algebraic components, not relative vector magnitudes.
A baseline closer to uniform on these seeds is consistent with its uniform component influencing rankings, not proof that derivative effects are unimportant elsewhere.
These are fixed seed-context dictionary contractions, not actual corpus contexts or full-model activations.
Broken pairing is a deterministic ablation; early is already trained and uses final-selected vocabulary/seeds.
No corpus, model execution, checkpoint weights, newly generated candidates, or ranking retuning was used.
interpretation: On the fixed256 initial contexts, first_order agrees with uniform top1 on178 pairs (69.53%) but with derivative-only top1 on7 (2.73%). Its top4 mean Jaccard is0.6343 versus uniform and0.0200 versus derivative-only: on these seeds the complete first-order ranking is substantially closer to its uniform component.

The derivative is not negligible: adding it to uniform changes the top1 on78 of256 contexts and the top4 set on187. Broken complete-QK/content pairing retains first_order top1 on182 contexts (71.09%); this deterministic ablation preserves the uniform term algebraically.

Early first_order has no top4 overlap with final first_order on any of the256 common seeds. This demonstrates changed checkpoint rankings on shared inputs, not a uniquely Shakespeare-specific code, causal storage localization, or passage recovery.
